calc_items.title: Furosemide dose arithmetic

calc_items.title: Arteriovenous O₂ difference
calc_items.question: O₂ consumption is 200 mL/min and cardiac output is 4 L/min. Calculate the arteriovenous O₂ content difference in mL/dL.
calc_items.working: 200 / 4 = 50 mL O₂ per L of blood = 5 mL/dL (Fick: VO₂ = CO × a–v O₂ difference)
